## Environment–Disease Modeling with AutoML and Spatial Random Forest

A reproducible machine learning workflow for studying the environment–disease nexus using spatial and environmental data.

The pipeline combines:

- AutoML for model and pipeline selection
- PCA for reducing multicollinearity
- Global Random Forest modeling
- Geographically weighted Random Forest for spatial heterogeneity
- SHAP for feature-level interpretation
- ALE for identifying nonlinear effects and thresholds

[Code & Documentation](https://github.com/ShaokunLyu/Auto-Machine-Learning-and-RF-Visualization){.btn .btn-primary}



## High-Resolution DEM Generator

A MATLAB-based system for generating high-resolution Digital Elevation Models from InSAR data.

The project translates a research workflow into a reusable application, supporting DEM generation and related data-processing tasks.

[Code & Documentation](https://github.com/ShaokunLyu/High-Resolution-DEM-Generator){.btn .btn-primary}
